preconditions.description: The number of nodes N must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of edges M must be between 1 and the maximum possible edges for N nodes.
The integer P must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A <= N and 1 <= B <= N for A, B in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid nodes within the range of 1 to N.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of critical links in the graph.
